input.command:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
feat(deploy-cloudflare): bridge raw Express handlers from access.ts into CF Workers

Adds a CF-to-Express bridge that makes accessRoutes (members, invites,
join-requests, board-claims, CLI auth, admin users) available in the CF
Workers deployment — these previously returned 501 because they use raw
Express handlers invisible to extractRoutesFromRouter.

- src/http/cf-express-bridge.ts: new bridge — buildMockReq/createMockRes/
  runChain implement the Express req/res API; bridgeExpressHandlers wraps
  any raw handler stack as a transport-agnostic Handler; extractAllRoutesFromRouter
  walks the Express router stack capturing both tagged and untagged routes.
- src/shims/node-dns.ts: stub shim for node:dns / node:dns/promises (access.ts
  imports dnsLookup at top level; the shim allows the module to be bundled,
  and the DNS-dependent route returns a rejection at runtime — acceptable).
- src/shims/node-net.ts: add isIP/isIPv4/isIPv6 exports (access.ts imports
  isIP from node:net; implemented in pure JS using regexp).
- build-worker.mjs: alias node:dns and dns/promises to the new shim.
- src/worker/route-registry.ts: import extractAllRoutesFromRouter + accessRoutes;
  append accessRoutes(db, opts) via the bridge to the compiled route list.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
input.description: Commit CF bridge and access routes wiring
